book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Matyhuho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesu Duichon ombusakungnihon ma torop
Oro, ngomai Yesu Duichon ombu sakungnihon ma torop. Yesu yu Devithon morogono, Devit yu Abrahamphon morogono.
Abraham yu Aisakhon fano, Aisak yu Jeköphon fano Jeköp yu Yuda yomot oröcma yuhon fano.
Yuda yu Peres orin Serahon fano. Yuhon macno woi Tamar, Peres yu Hesrönthon fano, Hesrön yu Ramphon fano,
Ram yu Aminadaphon fano, Aminadap yu Nasönthon fano, Nasön yu Salmonthon fano,
Salmon yu Böashon fano, macnoi Rahap, Böas yu wömai Öbethon fano, macnoi Rut, Öbet yu Yesihon fano,
Yesi yu King Devithon fano, Devit yu wömai Solomonthon fano. Solomonthon macno woi Uriahon oweno.
Solomon yu Rehöböamphon fano, Rehöböam yu Abiyahon fano, Abiya yu Asahon fano,
Asa yu Yehösafathon fano, Yehösafat yu Yöramphon fano, Yöram yu Usiahon fano,
Usia yu Yötamphon fano, Yötam yu Ahashon fano, Ahas yu Hesekiahon fano,
Hesekia yu Manasehon fano, Manase yu Amonthon fano, Amon yu Yösaiahon fano,
Yösaia yu Yöyakin orin orugi yuhon fano. Bongono wocin wömai Babilön nano yu Israel nano yangato fonguya youp wabkarac böyo- mo idung.
Ihoroc tongga idiya mongorec toctoc youp wo bödeuna wocin wömai Yöyakin yu Sealtielhon fano idoc. Sealtiel yu Serubabelhon fano,
Serubabel yu Abiuthon fano, Abiut yu Eliakimpon fano, Eliakim yu Asörhon fano,
Asör yu Sadökhon fano, Sadök yu Akimphon fano, Akim yu Eliuthon fano,
Eliut yu Eleasarhon fano, Eleasar yu Matanthon fano, Matan yu Jeköphon fano,
Jeköp yu Yösephon fano, Yösep yu woi Mariahon opno. Oro Maria yu wömai Yesu Duic bagoc. Duic wömai Kopotorocho ‘owi amna wontucmunodecma öcangyun muuya batip itnung’ yongo inong muuna eboc.

Oro Abrahamdecma forosingga toropni 14 ihoroc öngkung tonguya worocho menon Devitho öngkuboc. O wönggon Devitdecma forosingga toropni 14 ihoroc öngkung tonguya bongono wocin wömai Babilön nanoho Israel nano inoin youp amna boyömoha yangato fonggung. O Israel nano Babilön sae idiya wönggon torop 14 ihorocho öngkung tonguya Duic öngkuboc.
Mariaho Yesu Duic bagoc
Oro, Yesu Duic öngkubocmahon fatno wömai ingoroc: Amna morömaho Maria urop Yösephon fat bogigung. Tuya yu abe kondong maidinya Kunkun Yaruho tuna Maria yu mana modip idoc.

Oro opno Yösep yu amna nongnongo ididoc. Worocha tongga yu ‘Maria yangam fap tong imityit’ yongo suraroho yangamin mata youpdec tohong yucyucha makombigoc. Muno yu ‘owena öpgon fodingma ongoun’ yongo kombigoc.

Ihoroc kombingga idina duc itudec Morömahon sum yaru auho öngkung imongo inogoc, “Yösep, Devithon morogono, goc Maria tong sicsicha botirocha. Muno Kunkun Yaruho toroc kiap au tuna mana modip wo itac.

Yu woi managumboc amnano baangoc. Tuna gocho mano ‘Yesu’ ihoroc mambengoroc. Ma worochon foro wömai ingoroc: Yu owi amna wontucmunodecma öcangyun muuya batip itnahing.” Sum yaruho Yösep ihoroc inogoc.
Oro, manomano ngo öngkubocmaha tongga Kopotorocho osucgon yong tuctuc amnaho ducdecma mata yogocma worocho boinno öngkuboc. Mata wömai ingoroc yogoc,
“Kombiarut, kunkun owi berac au yu modip ito managumboc amnano baangoc. Yuhon mano wömai Emanuel ihoroc mambotnahing.” (Aisaia 7:14) Emanuel ma worochon foro wömai ‘Kopotoroc nonot itac’ ihoroc.
Oro Yösep yu duc itu ihoroc tongo wekongga Morömahon sum yaruho mata inogocma worochon toroc tanda Maria tong sigoc.
Maria tong sigoc mahong yu yuot kondong abe maidinya yu managumboc amnano bagoc. Bauna yuhon mano Yesu ihoroc mambodoc.
